activity.text: Added src/levels.js and src/dates.js, migrated tournaments to ISO date + time, rebuilt the console mobile-first, seeded Padel Tribe. 10/10 parser tests pass.

headline: Padel Tribe, Porto — date picker, validated skill levels, phone-first console
summary: Console at padel-tournament-planner.mike.users.ctx7.dev now stores the date as ISO + time behind a real date picker (min=today, past and >2y refused) and the skill level as a validated MX/M/F + grade 1-7 code, enforced identically on the web form and the !tournament command. Mobile rebuilt: no page
